section_summary.extract_value: This section reports the adaptation and psychometric evaluation of the Brazilian version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for adolescents aged 10–13, finding support for the original unidimensional factor structure and satisfactory internal consistency (α = .804). It describes negative associations between BAS scores and BMI (and positive associations with body satisfaction), notes higher BAS in normal-weight versus overweight groups, and highlights the sample drew from private and public schools with ethnic diversity but no formal ethnicity data collected. No numeric sample size, mean age, mean BMI, survey method, or correlation coefficients are reported in the text.
